resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Italian source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Italian pass identified 25 remaining grammar, terminology, notation, and unit-clarity defects across Ohm's law, Joule heating, Kirchhoff's laws, TCR, trigonometry, heat capacity, heat flux, SI units, and wire gauges; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Italian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The rearranged-formula instruction used an awkward literal construction.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said Utilizza la versione che mette il valore che vuoi trovare a sinistra.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as Usa la versione che mette a sinistra il valore che vuoi trovare.

findings.summary: The worked-examples heading was a literal phrase rather than the standard Italian term.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used Esempi realizzati.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Esempi svolti.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating description used an imprecise phrase for a resistive component.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said quando la corrente scorre attraverso la resistenza.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with riscaldamento per effetto Joule and un resistore.

findings.summary: The heating-power introduction used an unnatural adjective order.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said La potenza elettrica riscaldante è.
findings.resolution: Changed it to La potenza di riscaldamento elettrico è.

findings.summary: The paragraph incorrectly described electrical energy as a rate of energy transfer.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said L'energia elettrica è una velocità di trasferimento di energia.
findings.resolution: Corrected the subject to La potenza elettrica and retained the temperature distinction.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description used circuiti chiusi where the concept is conservation along closed loops.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation described conservation attorno ai circuiti chiusi.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with conservation of charge at nodes and energy along closed loops.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff summary used a less direct sentence structure.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation began Come si comportano la corrente e la tensione.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Il comportamento della corrente e della tensione nei circuiti collegati.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms introduction used an overly literal phrase about reasoning over a diagram.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said rendono più facile ragionare su uno schema elettrico.
findings.resolution: Changed it to I termini di base facilitano l'analisi di uno schema elettrico.

findings.summary: The branch definition omitted the preposition needed before corrente.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said Un ramo è un percorso corrente tra due nodi.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Un ramo è un percorso per la corrente tra due nodi.

findings.summary: The loop definition used the English loanword loop instead of an Italian technical phrase.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation began Un loop è.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Un percorso chiuso ritorna al punto di partenza.

findings.summary: The TCR example setup used an unnatural passive sentence structure.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said A 20 °C è specificata una resistenza di 1,00 Ω.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as Una resistenza da 1,00 Ω è specificata a 20 °C.

findings.summary: The TCR unit guidance used temperatures as the grammatical subject of using a scale.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said Le temperature devono utilizzare la stessa scala.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Usa la stessa scala e le stesse unità di temperatura.

findings.summary: The TCR applicability paragraph used a literal translation for thermal gradients and material changes.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used Gradienti di temperatura and cambiamenti di materiale.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with Gradienti termici and modifiche del materiale.

findings.summary: The trigonometry explanation used awkward wording for the opposite and adjacent sides.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation described the sine as opposto all'ipotenusa rather than defining the ratio.
findings.resolution: Rewrote the explanation with explicit seno = opposto/ipotenusa, coseno = adiacente/ipotenusa, and tangente = opposto/adiacente.

findings.summary: The radians formula localized the protected degree-variable name.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used θ_gradi instead of the canonical θ_deg variable.
findings.resolution: Changed it to θ_rad = θ_deg × π / 180.

findings.summary: The object/material heading used contro where the section compares two related concepts.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used Oggetto contro materiale.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Oggetto e materiale.

findings.summary: The material-property paragraph used a plural where the concept refers to the material in the example.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said La capacità termica specifica è una proprietà dei materiali.
findings.resolution: Changed it to una proprietà del materiale and clarified the mass relationship.

findings.summary: The total heat-transfer-rate definition had a redundant word order.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation said la velocità di trasferimento del calore totale in watt.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as la velocità totale di trasferimento del calore, misurata in watt.

findings.summary: The SI table heading said common units rather than base units.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used Unità SI comuni for the seven base units.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Unità di base SI.

findings.summary: The SI base-unit table capitalized the unit name kelvin inconsistently.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used Kelvin in the unit-name cell.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit name to lowercase kelvin while preserving symbol K.

findings.summary: The nano prefix used an uppercase N instead of the SI symbol n.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation listed nano with symbol N, which denotes a different SI prefix.
findings.resolution: Corrected the symbol to lowercase n.

findings.summary: The AWG formula localized the protected inch-diameter variable.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation used d_pollici instead of the canonical d_inch variable.
findings.resolution: Changed it to d_inch while retaining Italian decimal formatting.

findings.summary: The nominal-diameter instruction used an infinitive while the surrounding checklist uses direct instructions.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation began Includere il diametro nominale.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Includi il diametro nominale.

findings.summary: The dimension-type instruction was an incomplete literal fragment.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation began Indicare se la dimensione è conduttore nudo.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as Indica se la dimensione è quella del conduttore nudo, del diametro isolato, della lamiera o della parete del tubo.

findings.summary: The final wire-gauge bullet translated gauge number as manometer number.
evidence: The previous Italian presentation ended with dal numero del manometro, which refers to a pressure instrument.
findings.resolution: Changed it to dal numero del calibro and retained the instruction to use product data and electrical standards.
